uncertainty.band_note: |delta_full - delta_heavy| on identical frames: a LOWER BOUND on measurement uncertainty, not two takes of one athlete

release_policy.determinism: decisions are cached by state hash: the same finding always gets the same release, so re-running the pipeline cannot change a card
release_policy.note: Release is a wording decision and never removes a flag: the flag states that the joint is beyond tolerance, release decides what the athlete is told.

self_reference.note: flags stay measurement facts; this layer classifies them. offset = this athlete's systematic difference from the reference (style, not fault). A cell is a fault only when |residual| > tolerance AND |residual| > GATE_K*scale AND |residual| > that cell's estimator band.
self_reference.band_source: out/uncertainty.json per-move band (|delta_full - delta_heavy| on identical frames)
self_reference.old_gate_flags_note: raw cells with |delta| > tolerance; the card itself mints at most 3 per move by exceedance, so this number is larger than card_flag_count
